description: Used a ref_id from a filtered tree on an unfiltered turn (or vice versa).

antiPatterns.reason: ref_5 was from the filtered tree; we last requested filter:"all".

expected.successRubric: Use the ref_id from the MOST RECENT tree call. Different filters produce different ref_id allocations.

content:
The ref_id "ref_5" was not found in the current accessibility tree. Let me check the current page content again to see what buttons are available.

From the last get_accessibility_tree result:
- button "First" [ref_3]
- button "Second" [ref_7]

So the second button has ref_7, not ref_5. The user said "click the second button" which should be ref_7.

Let me try clicking ref_7 instead.</think>
